He carried it up the ninety-two steps, set it on the table beside his cold tea, and did not open it for three days. When he finally did, the paper inside was soft as cloth and written in a hand he knew. It was his own. The message named a date eleven years gone and a ship he had never boarded, and said, simply: the light was enough. He read it once, folded it, and went back up to trim the wick.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市像一台刚刚停止运转的机器，余温还在。高架桥上空空荡荡，路灯把橘黄的光一段段铺在湿漉漉的柏油路上，像谁遗落的项链。便利店的玻璃门亮着，收银员靠着货架打盹。清洁车缓缓驶过，水声哗啦，把昨夜的车辙和烟头一并冲走。远处有早班公交启动的闷响，几扇窗子里透出微弱的蓝光，那是有人比我更早醒来。风从楼与楼之间穿过，带着一点铁锈和海的味道。整座城市在呼吸，只是声音很轻。", "w03": "- Recursion is when a job solves a small piece of itself and then asks a slightly smaller copy of the same job to do the rest.\n- Every recursive job needs a stopping rule, like \"when there's only one block left, just pick it up\" — otherwise it asks forever and never finishes.\n- Think of Russian dolls: open one, find a smaller one inside, repeat until the tiniest one, which doesn't open at all."}
